scope: Actual gas transport with old-density/old-force and new-density/new-force half sources, common hierarchy timestep and fixed native topology. Independent source-field snapshots and per-leaf momentum/kinetic-work accounting.
limits: Noncosmological periodic smooth gas at one spatial resolution and short endpoint. No total QUMOND field-plus-gas energy conservation, exact self-force cancellation, particles/subgrid/MPI/regrid/restart or galaxy-formation readiness.
